1.web: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
1.asv: Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

2.web: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of your enemies.
2.asv: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

3.web: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
3.asv: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

4.web: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
4.asv: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.

5.web: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
5.asv: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

6.web: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
6.asv: He will judge among the nations, He will fillthe placeswith dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.

7.web: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
7.asv: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.
